evidence.detail: Standalone send() calls escape_underscores(content) before channel.send()
MtgMixin.single_card_text calls `await self.send(message)` — the Discord library method, which does NOT call escape_underscores
post_cards does use the standalone send/send_image_with_retry functions (which escape), but single_card_text does not

triage.fix_sketch: In discordbot/command.py line 281, change `await self.send(message)` to `await self.send(escape_underscores(message))`. The function is already imported at module scope. Optionally also apply it at line 259/263 in MtgMixin.send_image_with_retry.
triage.notes: The standalone send() path (used by legacy prefix-command helpers and post_cards) already escapes underscores. Only the MtgMixin.single_card_text path (slash commands) is unprotected. One-line fix.
